mechanism: First-in-class oral mutant-selective JAK2 V617F JH2 pseudokinase domain allosteric inhibitor
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Prospective exploratory evaluation of clonal HSC depletion and secondary marrow reticulin remodeling when WT JAK2 hematopoiesis is spared
anemia_and_iron_profile: Designed to avoid pan-JH1 wild-type EPOR/MPL blockade, preventing iatrogenic dose-limiting anemia and thrombocytopenia
strategic_lesson: De-risks human druggability of the V617F JH2 pocket (PDB:4FVQ/4FVR) while leaving next-generation catalytic JH2 PROTAC degraders wide open for startups

mechanism: First-in-class oral Type II DFG-out JAK2 inhibitor breaking Type I persistence
primary_endpoints: Safety, tolerability, & RP2D in Type I JAKi-failed MF
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Preclinical Type II JAK2 inhibition (CHZ868/AJ1-11095) achieved marked marrow reticulin regression alongside deep mutant VAF depletion
anemia_and_iron_profile: Requires careful therapeutic-window titration in cytopenic post-JAKi patients because JH1 DFG-out binding still engages wild-type JAK2
strategic_lesson: Directly tests Koppikar/Meyer Type I persistence biology (reversing Y1007/Y1008 hyperphosphorylation & JAK1/TYK2 trans-activation) in post-ruxolitinib failure

mechanism: Fully human monoclonal antibody selectively targeting cell-surface frameshift-mutant CALR-MPL complexes
primary_endpoints: Safety & tolerability in CALR-mutant MF and ET
Hematologic response, SVR35, & CALR VAF clearance
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Selectively depletes pathogenic CALR-mutant megakaryocytes and HSPCs—directly removing the cellular source of TGFB1 and CXCL4 in ~25-35% of PMF
anemia_and_iron_profile: Zero inhibition of wild-type JAK2/EPOR/MPL in normal bystander stem cells, yielding crisp lineage-sparing hematologic recovery
strategic_lesson: Proves true mutant-selective clonal clearance transforms MPN care—and highlights why intracellular JAK2 V617F (~55% of MF) requires small-molecule JH2/degrader chemistry

mechanism: Lipid-conjugated 13-mer oligonucleotide competitive inhibitor of human telomerase (hTERT) RNA template
status: Landmark OS Primary Endpoint Trial (Oct 2026 interim OS futility readout)
primary_endpoints: Overall Survival (OS) vs Best Available Therapy (excluding JAKi)
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Phase 2 MYF2001 showed ~40% >=1-grade marrow fibrosis improvement correlated with telomerase/VAF suppression, though Phase 3 missed interim OS superiority
anemia_and_iron_profile: On-target reversible Grade 3/4 neutropenia and thrombocytopenia require dose holds and transfusion support
strategic_lesson: Established FDA willingness to accept Overall Survival as a primary MF endpoint, while proving unstratified multi-year salvage OS trials desperately need earlier RDEA composite clonal/fibrosis surrogates

mechanism: Oral BET bromodomain (BRD2/BRD3/BRD4) epigenetic inhibitor suppressing NF-kB & MYC super-enhancers + ruxolitinib
primary_endpoints: Key secondary TSS50 at Week 24 (narrowly missed nominal p-value cutoff)
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Significantly higher rate of >=1-grade bone marrow reticulin fibrosis improvement and megakaryocyte cluster reduction vs ruxolitinib + placebo
anemia_and_iron_profile: Improved mean hemoglobin levels and reduced RBC transfusion burden relative to ruxolitinib + placebo
strategic_lesson: Canonical example of the 'Phase 3 SVR35/TSS50 crisis': biologically active combinations that improve spleen, anemia, and marrow reticulin risk regulatory delay when tethered to noisy Week-24 binary symptom diaries

mechanism: Oral BCL-XL / BCL-2 BH3-mimetic pro-apoptotic inhibitor + ruxolitinib
primary_endpoints: Secondary TSS50 (no improvement over ruxolitinib alone)
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Phase 2 REFINE showed ~25-35% >=1-grade fibrosis reduction and VAF decline, but Phase 3 symptom/cytopenia tradeoffs halted progression
anemia_and_iron_profile: Marked on-target Grade 3/4 thrombocytopenia (mature platelet survival depends on BCL-XL) plus anemia management complexity
strategic_lesson: Validates apoptotic clearance of persistent MPN clones while proving combo partners must avoid mature-platelet BCL-XL toxicity (favoring PIM1, MDM2, or JH2 selectivity)

mechanism: Oral MDM2-p53 interaction inhibitor restoring p53-mediated apoptosis in TP53-wild-type CD34+ MF clones
primary_endpoints: TSS50 at Week 24 post-randomization (in ruxolitinib suboptimal responders)
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Prior BOREAS/Phase 2 studies demonstrated circulating CD34+ cell clearance, mutant VAF reduction, and marrow fibrosis grade improvements
anemia_and_iron_profile: GI prophylaxis and intermittent dosing schedules mitigate myelosuppression while maintaining continuous ruxolitinib cytokine control
strategic_lesson: Gold-standard 'zero-washout' add-on trial architecture: ruxolitinib run-in selects true suboptimal responders, prevents cytokine-rebound dropout, and excludes TP53-mutant clones

agent_name: Selinexor + Ruxolitinib (SENTRY / XPORT-MF-034; see also NCT05210790 comparator)
mechanism: Oral Selective Inhibitor of Nuclear Export (SINE) blocking XPO1 to retain p53, IkB, & FOXO tumor suppressors in the nucleus
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Phase 1/2 XPORT-MF-034 demonstrated cytokine reductions, VAF declines, and preliminary marrow fibrosis stabilization/improvement
anemia_and_iron_profile: Manageable reversible nausea/cytopenias with dual antiemetic prophylaxis at 60 mg QW dosing
strategic_lesson: Illustrates active sponsor/FDA pivot from brittle dichotomous TSS50 percentages toward Absolute-TSS (Abs-TSS) and survival hazard-reduction signals

agent_name: Rusfertide (VERIFY — Polycythemia Vera Hepcidin Mimetic Counter-Indication Benchmark; paired with SENTRY MF trial forensics)
mechanism: Subcutaneous peptidic hepcidin (HAMP) mimetic inducing ferroportin (SLC40A1) degradation to restrict erythropoietic iron
status: Positive Phase 3 in Polycythemia Vera (STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED in Anemic MF/AIMF)
primary_endpoints: Absence of phlebotomy eligibility & hematocrit <45% control in PV
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Controls erythrocytosis in PV without cytoreduction; does not treat established MF marrow fibrosis
anemia_and_iron_profile: Intentionally restricts iron delivery to erythroblasts—therapeutic in iron-avid PV, but catastrophic if misapplied to high-hepcidin anemic MF or AIMF!
strategic_lesson: Essential bidirectional test of iron-hepcidin pharmacology for clinical AI agents: PV requires hepcidin agonism (rusfertide), whereas anemic MF requires hepcidin suppression (momelotinib ACVR1 blockade)

mechanism: Oral selective PIM1 serine/threonine kinase inhibitor targeting STAT5-driven pro-survival & profibrotic signaling
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Preclinical Pim1 ablation reverses JAK2 V617F marrow fibrosis; clinical responders show broad profibrotic cytokine reductions and marrow fibrosis improvements
anemia_and_iron_profile: Remarkably non-myelosuppressive (stable hemoglobin and platelet counts even in baseline severely thrombocytopenic patients), making it an ideal combo partner with momelotinib
strategic_lesson: Validates orthogonal non-cytopenic intracellular kinase inhibition (atypical Pro123 hinge) as a clean backbone for combination MF therapy

mechanism: Oral Type I JAK1 / JAK2 / ACVR1 (ALK2) inhibitor
status: FDA Approved (Sept 2023 — Ojjaara) for MF with Anemia
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Does not routinely clear established Grade 2/3 clonal marrow fibrosis or eradicate JAK2 V617F stem cells (Type I JH1 binder)
anemia_and_iron_profile: Suppresses hepatic BMP6/ACVR1 -> SMAD1/5/8 -> HAMP (hepcidin), restoring SLC40A1 ferroportin macrophage iron export and raising transfusion independence (~30% vs 20% danazol)
strategic_lesson: Proved commercial & clinical blockbuster value ($1.9B GSK acquisition) of solving functional hepcidin-mediated anemia alongside spleen/symptom control

mechanism: Oral JAK1-sparing Type I JAK2 / IRAK1 / ACVR1 / CSF1R inhibitor
status: FDA Accelerated Approval (Feb 2022 — Vonjo) for MF with Severe Thrombocytopenia (<50 x 10^9/L)
primary_endpoints: TSS50 at Week 24 in patients with platelets <=100 x 10^9/L
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: IRAK1/NF-kB suppression reduces IL-1b/TGFb inflammatory drive, though clonal persistence remains as a Type I JH1 binder
anemia_and_iron_profile: Dual JAK1-sparing + potent ACVR1 hepcidin inhibition yields meaningful RBC transfusion-independence gains alongside safe full-dose delivery at platelets <50 x 10^9/L
strategic_lesson: Carved a $1.7B Sobi acquisition niche by prospectively owning the cytopenic MF subpopulation excluded from COMFORT-I/II and JAKARTA; also repurposed into VEXAS (PAXIS NCT06538181)

mechanism: Oral JAK2-selective (over JAK1/3/TYK2) Type I JH1 & FLT3 inhibitor
status: FDA Approved (Aug 2019 — Inrebic; carries Wernicke encephalopathy Boxed Warning)
primary_endpoints: SVR35 at Week 24 confirmed 4 weeks later
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Minimal consistent histological fibrosis reversal or clonal eradication due to conserved WT/V617F JH1 binding
anemia_and_iron_profile: Lacks ACVR1 inhibition; causes on-target WT-JAK2 EPOR anemia/thrombocytopenia plus GI toxicity and mandatory baseline/periodic thiamine monitoring
strategic_lesson: Rescued from a multi-year FDA clinical hold once retrospective thiamine/Wernicke forensics clarified etiology—demonstrating asset-rescue value in orphan hematology

mechanism: Foundational oral Type I JH1 ATP-competitive JAK1/JAK2 inhibitor
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Rarely reverses established Grade 2/3 fibrosis within 1-2 years; clonal evolution (ASXL1, RAS, TP53) continues under Type I heterodimer persistence
anemia_and_iron_profile: Dose-limiting Grade 3/4 anemia (~45%) and thrombocytopenia (~13%) from WT-JAK2 JH1 inhibition; ~50% discontinue within 3 years (post-discontinuation median OS 11-23 mo)
strategic_lesson: Defined the modern MPN commercial category while creating the two largest unmet wedges in hematology: WT-sparing clonal clearance and post-ruxolitinib survival rescue

agent_name: MPN PROGRESSion Registry (Observational RWE & Biomarker Infrastructure)
mechanism: MPN Research Foundation 5,000-participant longitudinal linked EHR, claims, genomic, & PRO natural-history cohort
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Links serial real-world bone marrow pathology reports and NGS VAF panels across community and academic settings
anemia_and_iron_profile: Tracks real-world transfusion velocity, ruxolitinib-to-momelotinib/pacritinib switching, and iron-overload complications
strategic_lesson: Anchor ethical validation partner for External Control Arms (ECAs), no-washout trial matching, and RDEA digital endpoint qualification

agent_name: Prednisone / Rituximab / Mycophenolate Immunosuppression (Mayo Clinic AIMF Cohort, PMID:38342652)
mechanism: Polyclonal T/B-cell & autoantibody suppression extinguishing IL-6/IFNG/TGFB stromal irritation
status: Published Clinical Standard (Gangat, Reichard, Orazi & Tefferi, Br J Haematol 2024)
primary_endpoints: Complete Hematologic Response (74% frontline steroids; 80% rituximab salvage)
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Objective physical regression or complete resolution of MF-2/MF-3 human bone marrow reticulin fibrosis within 3-12 months ('Nature's Positive Control')
anemia_and_iron_profile: 59% initially transfusion-dependent with dual IL-6/hepcidin trapping + PRBC iron loading; immunosuppression restores transfusion independence, unmasking residual parenchymal iron
strategic_lesson: Proves human bone marrow fibrosis IS biologically reversible in vivo and exposes catastrophic diagnostic misrouting when AIMF is mistaken for Triple-Negative PMF

agent_name: Corticosteroids & Steroid-Sparing Immunosuppressants (French Multicenter AIMF Study, PMID:33054116)
mechanism: Systemic autoimmune suppression across SLE-, Sjogren's-, Evans-, & Primary-AIMF
status: Published Reference Cohort (Mertz et al., Haematologica 2021)
primary_endpoints: Steroid-sparing durability on MMF, azathioprine, or rituximab
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Repeat marrow biopsies confirmed marked reduction of reticulin fibrosis in hematologic responders, contrasting with futile cytopenic responses when misdiagnosed as PMF
anemia_and_iron_profile: Resolves DAT+ hemolytic/hypoproliferative anemia and normalizes inflammatory hyperferritinemia without myeloablation
strategic_lesson: Reinforces mandatory ANA/DAT/Ro-SSA serology + extended HMR NGS (excluding ASXL1/SRSF2) before prescribing JAKi or allo-HSCT to any triple-negative MF patient

agent_name: Reduced-Intensity Allogeneic HSCT & PAXIS Pacritinib Comparative Cohort in VEXAS (NCT05027945 / NCT06538181)
mechanism: Clonal eradication of somatic UBA1 p.Met41 HSCs via allo-HSCT vs JAK2/IRAK1 cytokine control via pacritinib
primary_endpoints: Transplant event-free survival & UBA1 VAF clearance (NCT05027945)
Clinical response & glucocorticoid taper in PAXIS (NCT06538181)
marrow_fibrosis_reversal_signal: Eliminating the UBA1-mutant myeloid clone resolves marrow erythroid/myeloid vacuolization, dysplasia, and secondary inflammatory reticulin
anemia_and_iron_profile: Reverses severe transfusion-dependent macrocytic anemia (MCV >100 fL) and chronic steroid-refractory IL-6/hepcidin block
strategic_lesson: Demonstrates the decisive diagnostic fork in JAK2-negative inflammatory marrow failure: polyclonal AIMF cures with rituximab/steroids, whereas somatic UBA1 VEXAS requires clonal myeloid eradication
